post.description:
Idealised direct-beam solar ENERGY availability for a site and window: an upper bound (sun-tracking panel,
any part of the Sun's disc counts as full illumination), with the position-sensitivity band carried from the
visibility result, the geometric (no-terrain) counterpart, the terrain penalty and the longest period without
sunlight. Sites without supporting terrain data return `terrain_data_insufficient` and no figures.

get.description:
What this running application is built from: code version, software, SPICE kernels and DEM windows
with SHA-256, the site catalogue and its sources, validation fixtures, constants and data classes.

post.description:
Compare several sites and/or dates. Supported scenarios get deltas and rankings (with position
bands); `terrain_data_insufficient` sites are listed separately and never ranked or scored.

Mission delay simulator: baseline window vs the same window shifted by each offset, with the position
band carried into every delta (paired per displacement).

One scenario. Returns `status: supported` with geometric and terrain-corrected results and position
bands, or `status: terrain_data_insufficient` with the reason and no numbers. The id identifies the
scenario (inputs + model + DEM); GET /scenarios/{id} returns it again.
